text: 你独自在北汉尼纳河岸徘徊，听见前方树林里传来行人的脚步声。起初，你因发现其他人而心头一喜；随即想起大树林给你上的残酷一课。他们未必友善。
你藏起来等他们经过。片刻后，一群男人出现了——他们身材矮小，皮肤呈不自然的灰色。其中一人手里拿着一个伐木工的断头。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 494
text: As you wander the banks of the North Hanninah alone, you hear the crackle of walkers in the woods ahead. At first, your heart leaps at finding other people, but then you remember the cruel lessons of the Big Woods. They may not be friendly.
You hide and wait for them. A moment later a party of men appears—undersized men, with unnaturally gray skin. One holds the severed head of a woodsman.
